cd "/Users/lesurmatthis/dev/projet perso/collega/collega_app"; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-lesurmatthis-dev-projet-perso-collega/21d61618-24eb-4775-bb63-b6c109928d29/scratchpad/scan.py <<'EOF'
import re,os,sys
for root,_,fs in os.walk('lib'):
  for f in fs:
    if not f.endswith('.dart') or f.endswith('.g.dart'): continue
    p=os.path.join(root,f); s=open(p).read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(Text|Text\.rich|TextSpan|RichText|EditableText|CupertinoTextField)\(',s):
      i=m.end(); depth=1; j=i
      while depth and j<len(s):
        if s[j] in '([{': depth+=1
        elif s[j] in ')]}': depth-=1
        j+=1
      body=s[i:j]
      # top-level style arg
      sm=re.search(r'\bstyle:\s*',body)
      line=s[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
      if not sm:
        print(f"{p}:{line}: NO STYLE {m.group(1)} :: {body[:80]!r}")
        continue
      k=sm.end(); d=0; e=k
      while e<len(body):
        ch=body[e]
        if ch in '([{': d+=1
        elif ch in ')]}':
          if d==0: break
          d-=1
        elif ch==',' and d==0: break
        e+=1
      st=body[k:e]
      if 'color' not in st and 'Color' not in st:
        print(f"{p}:{line}: {m.group(1)} style={st.strip()[:100]!r}")
EOF
